summary: Describes an optional IS-IS mechanism for running several independent IP topologies inside a single IS-IS domain. It can be used for things like a separate management network over the original one. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: One road network can have several separate sets of roads on top, such as one set for buses only. This lets a router network do something like it.

questions: how to run multiple topologies in is-is
